abstract: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDA-R) encephalitis is thought to be one of the common paraneoplastic-associated encephalitides. Between February 2001 and February 2011, nine patients were diagnosed with this disorder at Columbia University Medical Center: eight females (mean age 23 years) and one male (3 years of age). Four female patients had ovarian teratomas, which were removed as part of their treatment. Therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) was used as one of the treatment modalities in addition to immunosuppressive therapy, including corticosteroids, intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG), and/or rituximab. A total of 56 TPE procedures were performed in these patients on alternate days (range, 5-14 procedures/patient). Approximately 1 plasma volume (PV) was processed for all patients; 5% albumin and 0.9% normal saline were used as replacement fluid. Complications occurred in 20% of TPE procedures; 9% were possibly due to underlying disease. The remaining 11% of complications were hypotensive episodes that rapidly responded to either a fluid bolus or a vasopressor treatment. One patient demonstrated immediate clinical improvement after three TPE treatments, and four patients had significant improvement at time of discharge from the hospital. Long-term follow-up showed that early initiation of TPE appears to be beneficial, and patients who received IVIG after TPE did better than those who received IVIG before TPE. However, the number of patients in this series is too small to provide statistically significant conclusions. Overall, TPE is a relatively safe treatment option in patients with anti-NMDA-R encephalitis. Further studies are needed to elucidate the benefit of TPE in this disease.
abstract_ja: 抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体（NMDA-R）脳炎は、傍腫瘍性脳炎の一つと考えられている。2001年2月から2011年2月の間に、コロンビア大学医療センターで9例（女性8例、平均年齢23歳；男性1例、3歳）がこの疾患と診断された。女性4例は卵巣奇形腫を有しており、治療の一環として摘除された。治療的血漿交換（TPE）は、コルチコステロイド、静注免疫グロブリン（IVIG）、リツキシマブを含む免疫抑制療法に加えて用いられた。これらの患者に対して、隔日で合計56回のTPEが施行された（患者あたり5～14回）。約1血漿量（PV）を処理し、全例で5%アルブミンおよび0.9%生理食塩水を補充液として用いた。TPE施行の20%で合併症が発生し、そのうち9%は基礎疾患による可能性があった。残りの11%は低血圧発作であり、輸液負荷または昇圧薬で速やかに改善した。3回のTPE後に即座に臨床的改善を示した患者が1例あり、4例は退院時に有意な改善を示した。長期フォローアップの結果、TPEの早期開始は有益と考えられ、IVIGをTPE前に投与された患者よりTPE後に投与された患者の方が良好な経過をたどった。ただし、本研究の症例数は少なく、統計学的に有意な結論を導くには不十分である。総じて、TPEは抗NMDA受容体脳炎の患者にとって比較的安全な治療選択肢である。本疾患におけるTPEの有用性を明らかにするには、さらなる研究が必要である。
